Professor Ella Naparstek
Specialisation: haemato-oncology

Main areas of specialisation

Professor Ella Naparstek is a leading haemato-oncologist with more than 40 years of experience. She works at the Institute of Haematology of the Assuta medical centre. Professor Naparstek is known not only in Israel but abroad. She took part in opening the country's first bone marrow transplant department at the Hadassah clinic, and later opened a similar department at the Ichilov medical centre. She also took part in founding the Institute of Haematology at Assuta.

Professor Naparstek has unique experience, having performed her first bone marrow transplant in 1979. She has taken an active part in developing this method of treating blood disorders and uses innovative immunotherapy protocols that can be more effective for some patients.

Conditions treated:

Professor Naparstek treats various blood disorders and the complications associated with stem cell transplantation, including:

  • Leukaemia
  • Lymphoma
  • Hodgkin lymphoma
  • Multiple myeloma
  • Graft-versus-host disease
  • Haemophilia
  • Anaemia
  • Aplastic anaemia
  • Lymphogranulomatosis

Education and clinical experience:

  • 1968: Graduated from the faculty of medicine, Hebrew University.
  • 1974: Completed specialisation in haematology at the Hadassah medical centre.
  • 1978: Completed specialisation in the treatment of blood cancer by bone marrow transplantation at the Stanford University clinic, USA.
  • 1979: Began work as a senior physician in the haematology department of the Hadassah clinic.
  • 1985: Appointed senior physician of the bone marrow transplant department at the Hadassah medical centre.
  • 1999: Became head of the bone marrow transplant department at the Ichilov clinic.
  • 2014: Began work as a senior physician at the Institute of Haematology, Assuta clinic.

Academic and research work:

Professor Naparstek is not only a doctor but a well-known scientist and researcher. She is the author of more than 185 papers in international medical journals on haemato-oncology. Some of her research includes:

  • Treatment of aggressive non-Hodgkin lymphoma.
  • The use of immunotherapy and chemotherapy in treating blood cancers.
  • The accuracy of PET-CT in diagnosing blood cancer.
  • The effectiveness of various drugs for malignant blood disorders in patients of different ages.

Professor Naparstek also takes an active part in training medical students.

Membership of medical associations:

  • Israel Haematology Association.
  • American Society of Hematology.
  • European Hematology Association.
  • American Society of Clinical Oncology.
  • European Society for Blood and Marrow Transplantation.
  • American Society for Transplantation and Cellular Therapy.

Professor Ella Naparstek has made a significant contribution to the development of haemato-oncology, thanks to which many patients have received treatment of the highest quality and improved their quality of life.

Specialist in plastic and aesthetic surgery, head of the plastic microsurgery unit

Main areas of specialisation

  • Treatment of disorders of the facial and trigeminal nerves
  • Facelift
  • Breast surgery and reconstruction
  • Ear surgery
  • Abdominoplasty
  • Aesthetic and reconstructive surgery

Summary

Professor Eyal Gur is one of Israel's leading plastic surgeons, with more than 25 years of experience. He specialises in a wide range of procedures, including facelifts, breast surgery and reconstruction, ear surgery and abdominoplasty. Professor Gur is a recognised expert in plastic and aesthetic surgery, as his many awards and the appreciation of his patients confirm.

Education and clinical experience

Professor Gur took his medical degree and completed a fellowship in Toronto, Canada, where he mastered the newest methods and technologies of aesthetic microsurgery. He also specialised in paediatric plastic surgery at The Hospital for Sick Children.

Positions and achievements

Professor Gur holds key positions in a number of medical organisations:

  • Chairman of the Israel Society of Plastic and Aesthetic Surgery
  • Formerly headed the unit for the treatment of cleft lip and cleft palate for six years

Research and teaching

Professor Gur is the author of more than 97 research papers and a regular participant in scientific conferences. He is actively engaged in teaching, sharing his knowledge and experience with younger specialists.

Membership of professional organisations

  • American Society of Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery
  • International and American societies of reconstructive microsurgery
  • American Cleft Palate-Craniofacial Association
  • American Society of Reconstructive Transplantation
  • International society of reconstructive and aesthetic surgery

The doctor's main areas of specialisation

  • Plastic surgery in Israel. Facial aesthetics
  • Plastic surgery. Body aesthetics
  • Plastic operations

Professor Eyal Gur is a highly qualified specialist consulted by patients from Israel and abroad. His experience and professionalism allow him to achieve excellent results in plastic and aesthetic surgery, giving patients both physical and psychological recovery.

Otolaryngologist
Experience: 25 years

Specialisation

Professor Gideon Bahar is one of Israel's leading ENT surgeons. He currently holds the post of deputy head of the ENT department at the Assuta hospital. The main areas of his work include the diagnosis and treatment of:

  • Cancer of the larynx
  • Cancer of the lip
  • Cancer of the oral cavity
  • Thyroid cancer
  • Leukoplakia

Education and clinical experience

  • 2016: Deputy head of the ENT surgery department, Assuta clinic
  • 2015: Private practice at the Herzliya Medical Centre
  • 2012: Senior physician, otolaryngology department, Beilinson clinic (Rabin Medical Centre)
  • 2006: Advanced training in the surgical treatment of snoring and apnoea at the Stanford University clinic
  • 2000: Advanced training in the surgical treatment of head and neck tumours at a Toronto medical centre, Canada
  • 1995: Fellowship in ENT surgery at the Schneider children's hospital
  • 1993: Fellowship in surgery at the Beilinson Medical Centre
  • 1991: Faculty of Medicine, Technion, Haifa

Academic and research work

Professor Bahar is an authoritative specialist in the surgical treatment of head and neck tumours using modern surgical technology, including the da Vinci robot. He performs a wide range of operations on:

  • The sinuses
  • The oral cavity
  • The salivary glands
  • The larynx
  • The vocal cords

Professor Bahar also removes the thyroid gland by a robot-assisted method that leaves no marks on the neck. He is skilled in operations using the ultrasonic scalpel, ultrasound ablation and cold plasma. He performs operations by a distinctive endoscopic technique that he has described in the professional literature.

Alongside his clinical work, Professor Bahar is engaged in teaching. He lectures on ENT conditions to medical students at Tel Aviv University. His many research findings are described in international medical journals.

Membership of medical associations

Professor Gideon Bahar is a member of:

  • The Israel Society of Otolaryngology and Head and Neck Surgery
  • The Israel Association of Head and Neck Surgical Oncology

Oncologist, cancer surgeon

Main areas of specialisation:

  • Melanoma
  • Basal cell carcinoma
  • Squamous cell carcinoma of the skin
  • Soft tissue sarcoma
  • Cancers of the digestive tract
  • Breast cancer
  • Breast reconstruction

Summary:

Professor Haim Gutman is an internationally known cancer surgeon and an exceptional specialist in the diagnosis and surgical treatment of melanoma, basal cell carcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma of the skin, soft tissue sarcoma, and tumours of the digestive tract and breast. He has more than 40 years of clinical experience.

The professor's main area of specialisation is the treatment of melanoma, the most aggressive of all tumours known today. In Haim Gutman's view, accurate diagnosis is one of the most important factors in a patient's prompt recovery. He continually refines and develops his skill: he was among the first in the world to introduce sentinel lymph node biopsy. This procedure makes it possible to determine the extent of surgery reliably and to remove the growth while taking the least possible healthy tissue. To reduce the risk of recurrence the professor uses innovative methods, including neoadjuvant therapy with the newest drugs. The advanced technology of intra-operative isotope treatment helps the surgeon rule out side effects and complications as far as possible: a preparation is introduced into the patient's bloodstream and carried to the affected organ or tissue, where it irradiates the diseased area locally.

Professor Gutman is a proponent of organ-preserving surgery. In his practice he makes active use of minimally invasive laparoscopic and endoscopic methods, which reduce the patient's recovery time to a minimum. In difficult cases of breast cancer he resorts to partial or complete removal of the breast. Haim Gutman is also known as an excellent plastic surgeon who performs breast reconstruction after mastectomy with great skill. Preserving the appearance of the breast helps patients overcome psychological difficulties and return to a full life.

Professor Gutman graduated with distinction from the Sackler Faculty of Medicine at Tel Aviv University, becoming a certified specialist in surgery and basic sciences and, at the end of his training, in general and cancer surgery. He studied various surgical methods and cancer research at medical centres in the United States, the Netherlands and the United Kingdom. He currently heads a department of cancer surgery.

Professor Haim Gutman is actively engaged in cancer research. He lectures on courses in cancer surgery at various institutions, including universities in the United States. He has published more than 100 papers in the professional literature and is the co-author of numerous research works and publications in cancer surgery. Haim Gutman has received many awards and fellowships for his scientific achievements.

Education:

  • Sackler Faculty of Medicine, Tel Aviv University, Israel
  • Postdoctoral programme in cancer surgery, University of Texas, MD Anderson Cancer Center, Houston, USA
  • Advanced training in laparoscopic techniques, University of Texas, MD Anderson Cancer Center, Houston, USA

Languages:

  • Hebrew
  • English

Membership of international associations:

  • Israel Medical Association (IMA)
  • Israel Surgical Association
  • Israel Society of Surgical Oncology (ISSO)
  • Society of Surgical Oncology, USA
  • European Society of Surgical Oncology (ESSO)
  • Society for Melanoma Research (SMR)

Urologist

EXPERIENCE: 35 years

SPECIALISATION
Professor Haim Matzkin is a leading Israeli urologist. The main areas of his work are urological surgery and uro-oncology. He was invited to the Assuta clinic as a highly qualified specialist in the diagnosis, treatment and prevention of benign prostatic hyperplasia, chronic prostatitis and prostate cancer. He has experience of performing the most complex operations using the newest technical means.

  • Prostatitis
  • Carcinoma
  • Cancer of the urethra
  • Varicocele
  • Transurethral resection of the prostate
  • Prostate cancer
  • Bladder cancer
  • Testicular cancer
  • Benign prostatic hyperplasia

EDUCATION AND CLINICAL EXPERIENCE

  • 2006 — Private practice at the Assuta medical centre
  • 2005 — Private practice at the Top Ichilov medical centre
  • 1989 — Fellowship in uro-oncology at clinics in Memphis and Miami, USA
  • 1984 — Tel Aviv Ichilov medical centre — five-year fellowship in urology
  • 1979 — Physician in the armoured corps and head of the epidemiology unit in the Israel Defence Forces
  • 1977 — Fellowship at the Hadassah clinic
  • 1973 — Faculty of medicine, urology, Hebrew University of Jerusalem

LANGUAGES

  • Hebrew
  • English

MEMBERSHIP OF INTERNATIONAL ASSOCIATIONS

  • Israel Medical Association
  • Israel Urological Association
  • European Association of Urology
  • American Urological Association

Professor Hanoch Kashtan is a prominent Israeli surgeon with a rich experience of more than 35 years. He founded the oesophageal surgery unit at the Ichilov medical centre and is recognised as an authoritative specialist in the surgical treatment of various cancers, including cancer of the stomach, oesophagus and pancreas. The professor makes active use of the latest advances in endoscopic surgery, which allows the tumour to be removed as effectively as possible while minimising injury to the patient.

Where the organ cannot be preserved, Professor Kashtan demonstrates great professionalism in performing both open and minimally invasive operations. Besides treating cancer, he also specialises in other surgical interventions, such as the laparoscopic treatment of hernias.

The professor gained his experience not only in Israel but beyond it, with fellowships at leading medical institutions in the United States, Canada and France. Thanks to his experience and professionalism, Professor Kashtan has been able to help tens of thousands of patients.

In addition to his practice, Professor Hanoch Kashtan holds a number of key administrative posts in Israeli medicine and is actively engaged in research, having written more than 100 papers on cancer surgery published in leading medical journals.

EDUCATION

  • Faculty of medicine, Tel Aviv University, Israel
  • Fellowship in general surgery at the Ichilov medical centre, Tel Aviv, Israel
  • Fellowship in oesophageal surgery at the Hôpital de Rangueil in Toulouse, France
  • Master's degree in the faculty of medicine, University of Toronto, Canada
  • Fellowship at the Ontario Cancer Institute, Canada

LANGUAGES

  • English
  • Hebrew
  • French

MEMBERSHIP OF INTERNATIONAL ASSOCIATIONS

  • Israel Medical Association
  • Israel Surgical Association
  • European Association for Endoscopic Surgery
